body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> HiVi showcased its mini multimedia speaker Swans 'S3W' at CES 2010.

With its compact size, and combined digital amplifier volume controller, the HiVi Swans S3W mini multimedia speaker is especially suited for laptop users. It can reproduce an unexpectedly rich bass sound.

It is composed of three parts: patent volume controller with digital amplifier, right / left speaker and power adapter. Normally, the amplifier and volume controller are designed separately, which leads to complex wiring and sometimes causes electromagnetic interferences. The S3W combines the volume controller and amplifier into one unit to solve these problems and provide better control. The volume controller adopts the advanced high efficiency digital amplifier, SMT technology and refinement aluminum alloy enclosure.
